question: does a third source-grid level (128x64x64) continue the ratio trend toward 1 at the coarse canonical parameterization?
required_new_artifacts: new blockMeshDict + cell-order mapping + qualified transfer and injection on the refined source grid
decision: three levels of evidence: if the ratio keeps moving toward 1 and plateaus stay tight, register the trend; if it flattens above 1, the continuous-adjoint formulation needs revision; no Richardson/GCI from these levels
joint_refinement_requirement: future production configurations must refine the canonical and source grids together; the canonical-only refinement worsened the random-direction ratios
stop_conditions: no threshold change after seeing results
mesh gate measured before the campaign

budget.note: 128x64x64 is ~16x the coarse source grid per run
